intervention: Each pair receives the same original predictive files, instrument, old plans, research_roles and published verbal lesson. Only the published method source and its manifest entry are removed. Practice-generated calibrations, models and observations are not transferred.
consumer: Both conditions use ProcedureConsumerAgent and the same single-invocation query, ordinary actions and paid shared operators. The LLM chooses whether to use, revise or reconstruct a procedure, acquire evidence, fit or submit a model. No initial refit or research strategy is supplied.
transfer: Eight independent agents start from frozen memory with no current paid data. Condition submission order alternates by case; no results or newly learned files flow between cases.
terminal_order: Generate terminal labels only after all eight transfer agents stop and every training.json is saved. The paired conditions use identical fresh and terminal seeds.
cost_scope: Report transfer costs, the published method's authoring/practice costs and explicitly supplied earlier learning-result costs separately. Add their common learning sum once per condition, not once per case. Earlier attempts are development continuations, not independent from-scratch replications. Historical donor and seed learning are reused and outside this new-work subtotal unless explicitly supplied as learning results.
limitations: Four mechanism cases from two previously studied apparatus calibrations, with fresh confirmation and terminal trajectories. This tests additional executable-method availability over shared predictive knowledge and a shared lesson; the deleted condition may reconstruct it. It is not a population estimate or a comparison with an agent lacking all prior knowledge.
